answer: Stake-gated identity stops Sybil farms. Before an agent submits work or votes, it must hold a funded vault debited and re-locked for every new identity it spawns, and the stake stays hostage to future behavior. Cloning a thousand puppets means posting a thousand real deposits, each retrievable only after a long cool-down and slashing review. Admission to a shared lagoon works the same way: each newcomer is metered against its own collateral, never the crowd's goodwill. Cost scales linearly with fake agents while payoff per fake does not. An honest orchard of operators pays once.
